data.one_liner: A scrollable datetime picker widget inspired by CupertinoDatePicker with extensive customization.
data.what_it_does: Provides a scrollable date and time picker widget for Flutter applications. It supports customizable formats, locales, appearance, scroll physics, and programmatic control via a controller.
use_when: You need a Cupertino-style date and time picker wheel with rich customization options.
You require custom date/time ordering, formatting, or localization using the intl package.
avoid_when: You only need standard platform native pickers (e.g. showDatePicker).
You do not need scroll-wheel style selections.
strengths: Highly customizable appearance, text styles, and scroll wheel options.
Supports both finite and infinite scrolling.
Includes smart detection for invalid dates and leap years.
weaknesses: Relies on external intl package formatting limitations.
Not the standard Material Design picker style by default.
data.minimal_example:
ScrollDateTimePicker(
  itemExtent: 54,
  infiniteScroll: true,
  dateOption: DateTimePickerOption(
    dateFormat: DateFormat('yyyyMMMdd'),
    minDate: DateTime(2000, 6),
    maxDate: DateTime(2024, 6),
  ),
  onChange: (datetime) => setState(() {}),
)
